title: wg: §5.3 can't name a by-value proposal in invalidProposals; joint post with Haven (index in Commit.proposals)
description: Agreed with Jason Bolduc on #mimi (Zulip 238481, 240186): a ProposalRef can't name a proposal committed by value. Both prefer naming failing proposals by index in Commit.proposals; a #190 refusal reason can sit beside it. Jason drafts the list post and sends it to Mark before it goes to mimi@ietf.org. Waiting on his draft; posting needs Mark's OK. Must say it came out of the IETF 127 hackathon interop table.
